\"Show it in the preview\" keeps the fil: "Show it in the preview" keeps the file inside UltraFiler whenever it can show it - pictures, documents, spreadsheets, 3D models, e-books, fonts, video, audio and text - which is faster than starting a program for a look at a file.
\"Start the registered program\" is what: "Start the registered program" is what a double-click does in Explorer and the Finder: the file opens in the program its type is assigned to, and UltraFiler stays as it is.
A file cannot replace a folder.
A file merely open elsewhere - which on: A file merely open elsewhere - which on this kind of system blocks nothing - is marked O instead, and wears no padlock.
A file the system does not call hidden -: A file the system does not call hidden - Sti_Trace.log, Thumbs.db, desktop.ini - is not covered by this switch. Display > Ignored files is what leaves those out.
A file this system has no program for is: A file this system has no program for is shown in the preview either way, so this never turns a double-click into nothing happening. Whichever is chosen, the context menu's "Open with" still starts a program, and a file that cannot be previewed - a program, an installer, a file type UltraFiler does not read - always goes to the system.
A held file wears a padlock on its icon: A held file wears a padlock on its icon and an X among its attributes, and the info bar says so - which is the answer to a copy, a rename or a delete that fails with "the file is open in another program". The Attributes dialog names that program.
A kind switched off - or one format tick: A kind switched off - or one format ticked off under it - keeps its type glyph and is not read at all. Greyed formats: nothing in this build renders them.
A kind switched off - or one format ticked off under it - leaves the whole width to the file display. Greyed formats: this build has no view for them.
A move asks because it changes where the: A move asks because it changes where the files live; a Ctrl+V copy is deliberate and never asks. Moving to the Trash can be undone from there, which is why its question can be switched off; a permanent delete cannot, and always asks.
A name is broken between words where it: A name is broken between words where it can. When it needs more rows than allowed, the start of the last row is left out and replaced by "…", so the end of the name and its extension stay readable; hovering the tile shows the whole name.
A password-protected PDF or UltraCanvas: A password-protected PDF or UltraCanvas image in the preview is opened with Unlock, and its password is kept while the folder is browsed, so going back to it - or on to another file there with the same password - asks nothing.
A pattern is matched against each name i: A pattern is matched against each name inside a packed folder, ignoring case: "*" stands for any run of characters, "?" for one; with a "/" it is matched against the path inside the folder ("src/*.o"). A matching folder is left out with all it holds; what you selected is always packed. ZIP and 7-Zip are not affected by this page.
A pattern is matched against the name, i: A pattern is matched against the name, ignoring case; "*" stands for any run of characters and "?" for one, so "*.bak" hides every backup file. Folders are matched the same way.
A thumbnail costs far more to make than: A thumbnail costs far more to make than to keep: a folder of photos, videos or documents is minutes of work the first time it is opened. Kept on disk, that is paid once instead of once per start.
A type this system has no icon for keeps: A type this system has no icon for keeps the simple one, and so does every icon until its lookup lands: the display never waits for the host and never shows an empty box. With host icons on, a folder is drawn with the system's folder icon, so the pictures inside it (Display > Thumbnails) no longer peek out of it.
